title: Edgar Cayce Foundation funded Zahi Hawass

tellings.quote:
So the Edka Casey Foundation
funded Zahawas.

plain: A podcaster named Jay Anderson, speaking with Jesse Michels and comedian Kurt Metzger, says that the Edgar Cayce Foundation, a group built on the readings of a famous American psychic, paid for the work of Zahi Hawass, Egypt's best-known archaeologist and longtime head of its antiquities. He places this roughly in the 1980s into the early 1990s. If true, it would tie mainstream Egyptian archaeology to a group with mystical beliefs about ancient Egypt.
